data.content_ref: inline:The claim in SRC_003 that intuition is superior for high-interdependency tasks contradicts the premise of SRC_002 if the 'trap' variables in SRC_002 are themselves interdependent; essentially, if the checklist can neutralize biases in complex patterns, the 'gestalt' advantage of the expert is diminished. This relation is refuted if checklists are proven incapable of guiding non-experts through non-linear variable interactions.
